documentation.content:
The health check on `/actuator/health` is failing from two or more locations, so customers probably can't reach the app.

1. Look at Cloud Run → nordic-onboarding → **Revisions** and **Logs**.
2. If the latest release is the cause, send traffic back to the previous revision (no rebuild):
   `gcloud run services update-traffic nordic-onboarding --region=europe-north1 --to-revisions=PREVIOUS_REVISION=100`

conditions.displayName: Health check failing from 2 or more locations
